Maya K: Quick heads-up — I have a gap this weekend around APAC.
Maya K: I'm primary starting Fri 22:00 UTC -> Sat 10:00 UTC. I need to step out Sat 06:00 UTC for a family thing (will be unreachable for ~4 hours). Isha is listed as secondary but she marked OOO Sat 06:00 -> Sat 14:00 UTC. That leaves Sat 06:00-14:00 UTC uncovered. Can someone pick up primary for that window? @jared @isha :pray:
Jared L: I can take Sat 06:00-14:00 UTC primary if someone can cover my late-Sun window (Sun 18:00-02:00 UTC). I have a dentist appt Sun 19:00 local but otherwise available. :+1:
Isha P: Sorry — the OOO is fixed. I can't slide that. If Jared can take Sat morning I'm OK to be secondary for the late-Sun swap if needed.
Maya K: Thanks. Quick checklist for whoever picks this up:
- Check active incidents (INC list) and in-progress runbook steps
- Confirm PagerDuty primary assignment and Slack presence
- Run the sanity checks on the routing service (see runbook link)
- Leave a short handoff note before stepping out (open incidents + outstanding alerts)

Maya K: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff
Maya K: Quick commands (PagerDuty CLI):
```
pd schedule-override create --user email@redwood.com --start 2024-04-06T06:00:00Z --end 2024-04-06T14:00:00Z --schedule-id PABC123
pd incidents list --status triggered
```
Maya K: Also check the oncall dashboard: https://observability.redwood.internal/oncall

incident-bot: Active incidents summary: INC-4829 (v2-routing latency) — yellow, INC-4835 (embed batch failures) — orange. See https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-4829

Jared L: I'm happy to take Sat 06:00-14:00 UTC primary. I'll set the schedule override now and add a handoff note.
Jared L: Setting override...
OpsPager: PagerDuty override created by jared.l — schedule PABC123 — start 2024-04-06T06:00:00Z end 2024-04-06T14:00:00Z
Jared L: Handing off: INC-4829 has an ongoing velocity spike on the us-east routing tier, last action was circuit-breaker rollback at 2024-04-05T21:18Z. Monitoring for repeated alerts. INC-4835 intermittent 502s on /v1/embeds; team is investigating a flaky worker. No customer-facing outages currently.
Isha P: Thanks Jared — I can cover your Sun 18:00-02:00 UTC if needed. Please add the override and ping here when done.
Jared L: Added my late-Sun swap to schedule: override id OVR-998. @Maya K you should be clear to step out. I'll be primary and monitor alerts. Please leave any local notes in the handoff doc.
Maya K: Awesome, thank you both. I'll paste my brief handoff in case it's helpful:
```
Handoff notes (Maya):
- Look at INC-4829: last 24h latency spikes are tied to model-quantization job at ~02:00 UTC — mitigation is to throttle that job via infra flag: infractl jobs set-rate quantize 0.5
- Embed failures: retry workers have been cycling; suppressant rule applied yesterday. Watch rate of 502s on /v1/embeds
- Pager: escalation policy set to primary -> secondary -> oncall-leads
```
Maya K: If anything pages, please escalate per runbook. Isha — thanks for the swap offer, team — really appreciate it. :heart:
Jared L: Got it. I'll stay on top of alerts, will post 06:15 UTC quick status ping here after checks.
Jared L: 06:15 UTC status: no new pages, INC-4829 still yellow, traces look stable. Continuing watch.
Maya K: Logged — enjoy the weekend everyone. I'll be offline from 06:00 UTC.
